extracted.name: Raspberry Vinaigrette Dressing
extracted.description: Everything goes into a jar and you give it a good shake. That's all there is to it - oil, raspberry vinegar, sugar, mustard, oregano and pepper.
instruction_lines: In a jar with a tight fitting lid, combine the oil, vinegar, sugar, mustard, oregano, and pepper. Shake well.
